code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row)), None)
    if marker_row is None:
        return out
    for c, color in enumerate(grid[marker_row]):
        if color in (2, 8):
            height = 4 if color == 2 else 3
            for d in range(1, height + 1):
                r = marker_row - d
                if r < 0:
                    break
                out[r][c] = color if d == height else 1
    return out
'''
